name: Solarium Green Energy Ltd
tagline: SME solar EPC / rooftop installer that has de-rated ~60% from its high - real order intake (Rs 188 Cr MAHAGENCO award) against a Rs 368 Cr revenue base, but a commoditised, working-capital-heavy business with no pricing power
business_overview: Solarium Green Energy Ltd (BSE/NSE SME: SOLARIUM, listed early 2025), incorporated 2018, provides integrated / turnkey solar EPC and O&M for residential, C&I and government customers and trades solar products (PV modules, inverters, meters). Promoter holding ~58.6%.
fundamentals_table: 2026-04-02: Letter of Award Rs 188 Cr as sub-contractor for EPC + 3-year O&M of a 50 MWac solar PV project under MAHAGENCO, Maharashtra (~half a year's revenue)
fundamentals_narrative: The headline ratios look fine - ~23% ROE, ~20% ROCE, 55% 3-year revenue CAGR, PAT ~Rs 20.5 Cr on ~Rs 368 Cr revenue - and the Rs 188 Cr MAHAGENCO award is genuinely material against that base. But the market has taken the stock down ~60% from its high, and the reasons are visible in the model: solar EPC / rooftop installation is a low-barrier, tender-driven activity with no pricing power, ~151-day debtors tie up cash, and a single large sub-contract carries execution and receivable risk. Annualised PAT is ~Rs 20 Cr against a ~Rs 313 Cr market cap (~15x earnings, ~0.85x sales) - not expensive, but not a set-up where a 10x re-rating is on offer for a commoditised installer. No independent ValuePickr scrutiny exists.
technical_read: Not pulled - SME micro-cap, no ValuePickr thread; stock near 52-week low after a ~60% drawdown.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread (forum search returned nothing). Step 3.05: no match; topic_slug null. Research is web/filings-based only.
bse_notes: Sovrenn note (2026-04-02): Rs 188 Cr Letter of Award, sub-contractor EPC + 3-year O&M, 50 MWac solar PV under MAHAGENCO. Verified as a real, sizeable order (~0.5x FY26 revenue) - it holds up as a datapoint but does not by itself change the business quality.

value_chain.position: Downstream turnkey EPC + O&M contractor and solar-product trader - installs, does not manufacture cells, modules or inverters
value_chain.bottleneck_node: None captured by the installer - module supply, financing and tender pricing sit with others
value_chain.note: Downstream solar EPC is the least defensible layer of the value chain: many SME entrants, module cost pass-through, tender-driven margins and stretched receivables. Order intake scales with India's solar build-out but pricing power does not accrue here.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Order/project business; quarter-by-quarter revenue is lumpy and tied to project milestones. FY26 revenue ~Rs 368 Cr against a 55% 3-year CAGR off a small base.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~15x trailing earnings for a commoditised installer already prices in continued growth; the re-rating optionality is limited and the 60% drawdown shows how quickly sentiment can reverse.

bull_case: Rs 188 Cr MAHAGENCO sub-contract is large (~0.5x FY26 revenue) and confirms the company wins utility-scale work
Healthy reported returns (~23% ROE, ~20% ROCE) and ~55% 3-year revenue CAGR off a small base
Stock has already de-rated ~60% - some bad news is in the price
Tiny absolute size - room to compound if order flow becomes repeatable and margins hold
bear_case: Commoditised, low-barrier solar EPC / installation - no pricing power, module cost pass-through, tender-driven margins
Working-capital heavy: ~151-day debtors; a single large sub-contract concentrates receivable and execution risk
~60% drawdown in a year signals real derating / demand or margin concern the SME disclosures don't fully explain
~14 months of listed history, no institutional or community coverage, Sovrenn datapoint unverified against filings
verdict_headline: Sovrenn-news seed - real, material order against a small base, but a commoditised working-capital-heavy solar installer; scored 10x-in-2-3-years only at Low conviction with an 'unconfirmed' caveat
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn-news seed (tier 4.65). The Sovrenn datapoint (Rs 188 Cr MAHAGENCO award) is verified and material (~0.5x FY26 revenue), so per the trailing-average-vs-live-inflection rule this is not a flat 'neither' - a strong specific catalyst + a small base earns a 10x-in-2-3-years tag at Low conviction with an explicit 'unconfirmed' caveat.

The caveat does most of the work: downstream solar EPC has no pricing power, ~151-day debtors, and the ~60% one-year drawdown shows the market is already discounting execution / margin risk. A 10x from here needs both a large earnings ramp and a multiple that installers rarely command.

No live-theme match (solar EPC is not a listed active theme; the EV/BESS theme is priority-2 and only tangential). No red flag (profitable, promoter ~58.6%, no SEBI/auditor/going-concern issue). conviction Low; revisit_after_30d false. Re-check once 1-2 quarters show whether the MAHAGENCO order converts cleanly and receivables normalise.

four_box.note: India solar build-out is a real demand driver, but value_chain explicit: 'none captured by the installer' at this EPC layer (moat=no); ~60% drawdown shows market already pricing execution risk.
